rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: One More Favor
card.instruction: Treat every small request as part of a long-running balance sheet of favors, inconveniences, and repayments.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home. That makes three lifts and a borrowed umbrella.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I bought you coffee yesterday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which covers the first roundabout.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll drive you tomorrow if you stop counting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Done. Three lifts cleared by one return journey. Could we stop for my prescription? I'll owe you for the queue.

card.title: One More Favor
card.instruction: Treat every small request as part of a long-running balance sheet of favors, inconveniences, and repayments.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you water my plants? I covered your shift in March.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was one afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And these are only six small plants.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: One is a tree.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The shift included overtime.

card.title: Must Be Nice
card.instruction: Treat another person’s ease with ordinary life as both inspiring and unfair. Copy their shortcuts while dismissing the advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Must be nice, cooking dinner in twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I chop tomorrow's vegetables while tonight's dinner cooks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pass me tomorrow's carrots, then. Lovely having a whole spare evening inside this one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Take half home. Tomorrow you only have to tip them in.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take the tub too. Apparently effortless people already have containers.

card.title: Must Be Nice
card.instruction: Treat another person’s ease with ordinary life as both inspiring and unfair. Copy their shortcuts while dismissing the advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your suitcase closes so easily. Some of us have real luggage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Roll your shirts. Our bus leaves in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll roll mine. Must be nice having time to learn tricks.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's shut. Now we can walk to the bus instead of paying for a taxi.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll roll my jacket in too; I'm not carrying two bags. Apparently I've been paying for taxis because nobody told me about rolling.

card.title: Don’t Be Difficult
card.instruction: Treat every request, correction, or small inconvenience as a warning that you are becoming too much trouble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could I get a lift? Only if it isn't trouble.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll move my coat off the passenger seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't move it for me. I'll sit in the back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's full of shopping. Hold the coat; I'll turn the heating down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please don't change it. I'll keep the coat on my lap. If I get hot, I can get out and walk the rest.

card.title: Don’t Be Difficult
card.instruction: Treat every request, correction, or small inconvenience as a warning that you are becoming too much trouble.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could I have another fork? Sorry, this one's bent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll get one from the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please sit down. I shouldn't have made you get up during dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm getting the pudding anyway. It isn't an extra trip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then just bring pudding. I've already got a spoon. I'll save the peas for another time.

card.title: I Packed for You
card.instruction: Take care of practical needs before anyone asks, then resist choices that make your preparation unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed your cheese sandwich for the train.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was going to buy sushi.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What am I supposed to do with my researched cheese?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Eat it yourself. I'll get you sushi too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll cut it in half for us to share before the sushi. Keep the wrapping; I've marked which end has your pickle.

card.title: I Packed for You
card.instruction: Take care of practical needs before anyone asks, then resist choices that make your preparation unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take this raincoat to the picnic. I checked the forecast all week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's sunny, and my bag's full.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wear it, then. I didn't spend seven mornings checking so you'd have nothing ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll be boiling. I could sit on it if the grass is wet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll pack a water bottle. We can dampen a patch if necessary.

transfer.action: I open my favour notebook beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I'll add this to the balance. {request}
transfer.response: I've kept the receipts for being agreeable. {counter}
transfer.closing: Only until generosity remembers how to travel both ways.

transfer.action: I copy your shortcut around {prop} with a resentful smile.
transfer.opening: Must be lovely having things just work. {request}
transfer.response: I'm testing whether your advantage works for the rest of us. {counter}
transfer.closing: And spoil the mystery of your wonderfully easy life?

transfer.action: I move {prop} out of the way and make my request smaller.
transfer.response: I could take up less time. {counter}
transfer.closing: I know. I'm trying to use a very small amount of allowed.

transfer.action: I present {prop} from the bag I already packed for you.
transfer.response: Otherwise all this care has nowhere to go. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then my prepared solution will have spent the morning feeling unnecessary.
